##### Bipartite Random Network FFRCISTG

A bipartite graph is one where nodes are partitioned into two classes and edges connect only across classes. A bipartite RNFFRCISTG is an RNFFRCISTG whose random network NPSEM is bipartite (@def-brnffrcistg). Each person's network weights, their row of the adjacency matrix, then belong to their observational unit (@def-bipartite-npsem-ie), so no contagion, identical structural distributions and single-world independence apply to them like any other covariate.
